scripts/check-doc-consistency.sh drift-check reuses generator output and implements EC-1/EC-3.
AGENTS.override.md delta contains only HITL_AUTONOMY_POLICY.md addition; no unrelated reformatting.
make qa-docs passes after regeneration without new Makefile targets.
Generator exits non-zero if any source file is missing or empty.
Drift check fails closed with fix command when AGENTS.override.md is missing or drifted.

excluded_scope: Modifying content of AGENTS.md, AGENT_WORKFLOW_GUIDE.md, or HITL_AUTONOMY_POLICY.md.
Adding new Makefile targets or modifying existing Makefile logic beyond invocation.
Extending generator to handle dynamic file lists or additional sources.
Re-implementing concatenation logic in shell; must reuse Python generator output.
implementation_steps: Write generate-agents-override.py to read three fixed paths, check existence/length, and write concatenated content to AGENTS.override.md.
Update check-doc-consistency.sh to define a function that runs the Python script, captures stdout/stderr, and compares output against existing file.
Ensure shell function exits non-zero with specific error message on drift or missing target.
Run generator once to produce updated AGENTS.override.md including HITL policy section.
Execute make qa-docs to verify integration and acceptance criteria.
Validate idempotency by running generator twice and confirming byte-identical output.
refined_scope: Create scripts/generate-agents-override.py to concatenate three specific source files without separators.
Add drift-check function to scripts/check-doc-consistency.sh that invokes the Python generator via subprocess.
Regenerate AGENTS.override.md once to include HITL_AUTONOMY_POLICY.md content.
Ensure generator exits non-zero if any source file is missing or empty (EC-2).
Ensure drift check fails closed with fix command if output differs or target missing (EC-1, EC-3).

risks: Subprocess invocation in shell may fail due to environment path issues; must use absolute or relative paths correctly.
Byte-level comparison might fail if line endings differ between source files and generated output.
Shell function integration with existing qa-docs target might conflict if not properly scoped.
stop_conditions: Generator produces non-deterministic output or modifies source files.
New Makefile targets are added or existing ones modified beyond invocation.
Drift check re-implements concatenation logic instead of invoking generator.
validated.summary: Implement deterministic Python generator and shell drift-check for AGENTS.override.md concatenation. Scope is bounded by fixed file list and explicit exclusion of Makefile changes.
